observations: A standing figure with a wide rectangular head occupies the center; black and off-white fill the torso in vertical stripes, with dark shadow shapes pooling beneath the arms and feet.
Yellow and red lines run as separate loose loops across the entire canvas, forming small rectangular detours in the background that echo the figure's blocky head without consistently touching it.
Two circular eye forms near the top of the head are outlined in yellow with red spirals inside; the open mouth below is a dark void framed by the same yellow-red line system.
reading: A blocky standing figure is held together by two independent line systems—yellow and red—that wander the background as rectangular loops before converging on the face. The striped torso reads as both solid and hollow at once, the dark voids at the eyes and mouth pulling against the off-white fill. That tension between structure and gap gives the image an unsettled, watchful feeling.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between nnxyz nnotb #15—a layered flowing composition in warm blues and golds with no standing figure—and nnxyz nnotb #17, which shares the same sage-green ground and a frontal figure built from exposed structural lines.

connections.reason: nnxyz nnotb #17 shares the same sage-green ground and a frontal figure built from exposed structural lines, making the two a direct formal pair in the owned nnotb subset despite different line colors and silhouettes.

nnxyz nifty faces #96 uses a stacked rectangular head with boxed eye zones and an open-tooth mouth, offering a close formal parallel to the head here, though on a flat orange ground without a full body.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly do the yellow and red line loops touch or avoid the figure's outline—and does that boundary hold consistently across the whole image?
ambiguities: The relationship between the background rectangular loops and the figure's contour is visually ambiguous in places; it is unclear whether they share anchor points or run fully independent.
nnxyz nnotb #15 offers no useful formal connection to this work beyond title adjacency and was not selected as a comparison.
